# AMNI-SCIENT

> Engineering software that runs in the browser: Amni-CAD (parametric CAD with stress, flow and CAM) and Amni-Calc (engineering calculators). Also known as amnicad, Amni CAD, amnicad API.

## Amni-CAD for AI agents

There are two ways for an agent to use Amni-CAD.

- [Amni-CAD MCP server](https://amni-scient.com/cad/): drives Amni-CAD open in the user's browser. Free, no license key. In Amni-CAD open the assistant panel, expand "Other apps, or an AI app on my phone", turn on the remote link and copy its URL (https://amnicad-relay.amnibro7.workers.dev/mcp/<secret>, Streamable HTTP, no authentication). Codex: `codex mcp add amnicad --url <URL>`. Claude Code: `claude mcp add -s user --transport http amnicad <URL>`. Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add -s user -t http amnicad <URL>`. GitHub Copilot CLI: `copilot mcp add --transport http amnicad <URL>`. Microsoft Copilot Studio: agent → Tools → Add a tool → New tool → Model Context Protocol, authentication None. Cursor, Windsurf, LM Studio and VS Code (GitHub Copilot agent mode) take it as a remote (HTTP) MCP server in their MCP config. The page must stay open while the agent works.
- [Amni-CAD headless API](https://amni-scient.com/amni-cad-api): the engine without the editor, as the `amnicad` command and a local HTTP API at http://127.0.0.1:41800/v1/ (Bearer token from `node amnicad.mjs token`). Needs an Amni-CAD Pro or Enterprise license key. Install: `curl -fsSLO https://amni-scient.com/cad/api/amnicad.mjs`, then `node amnicad.mjs activate <AMNIPRO key>` and `node amnicad.mjs serve`. Jobs: build, export (STEP, STL, BREP), stress, flow, nonlinear, quote, dxf, toolpath, review.

## Products

- [Amni-CAD](https://amni-scient.com/amni-cad): parametric CAD, FEA, CFD, CAM and quoting in the browser
- [Amni-CAD headless API docs](https://amni-scient.com/amni-cad-api)
- [Amni-CAD function reference](https://amni-scient.com/amni-cad-reference/): every model feature, ready-made part recipe, AI assistant (MCP) tool and headless API route, with fields, defaults and examples. Machine-readable list: https://amni-scient.com/amni-cad-reference/index.json
- [Amni-Calc](https://amni-scient.com/amni-calc): engineering calculators (beams, springs, fatigue, bolts, gears, fluids, thermal)
- [Amnitex (atex)](https://amni-scient.com/amnitex): free, local, MIT-licensed tool that saves context and tokens in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI and other AI coding assistants. It compacts Claude Code sooner and restores state afterward, keeps long command output on disk, and stores the project and every turn for exact recall over MCP (atex_where, atex_search, atex_recall, atex_remember). Install: Windows PowerShell `irm https://amni-scient.com/atex-install.ps1 | iex`; macOS and Linux `curl -fsSL https://amni-scient.com/atex-install.sh | sh`. Source: https://github.com/Amnibro/amnitex. Not the same as AmniTex Railgun, a separate model-compression research project.

## Helium and Gold
- [API library](https://amni-scient.com/api-library/): every Gold command and every Helium function, type and constant, grouped by what it does and searchable. Machine-readable list with signatures and descriptions: https://amni-scient.com/api-library/index.json
- [Gold](https://amni-scient.com/gold): programming in plain English that compiles to checked Helium
